Higher-confidence resources support project evaluation, though a resource estimate is not an Ore Reserve and does not demonstrate economic viability.
Measured classification can support detailed mine planning and financing discussions, subject to further study and conversion to reserves.
OSS pit-shell estimate varies by only ±2%
The updated model largely confirms the May 2025 scoping study resource basis; no prior-period resource comparison figure is stated here.
PFS publication targeted for Q1 CY27
The study is the next key project milestone; timing remains a company target, not a completed outcome.
36koz at 2.04 g/t Au in shallow domains
These are currently inferred resources and potential upgrade targets, not established reserves.

This is a resource-classification update for an early-stage gold development project, following the May 2025 scoping study. Delivery of the targeted Q1 CY27 pre-feasibility study and conversion of resources into Ore Reserves would be needed to establish a larger development catalyst.
